title: Determination of antibodies binding specificities by printed glycan array technology
protocol: Incubate glycochips in an incubation chamber for 15 min at 25 °C with PBS plus 0.1% (v/v) Tween-20.
Remove buffer from the microchip surface using Whatman® filter paper.
Dilute αGal-KO mouse serum 1:15 in PBS plus 1% (w/v) bovine serum albumin and 1% (v/v) Tween-20.
Spread diluted serum over the slide surface.
Incubate with agitation at 37 °C for 1.5 h.
Wash glycochips with buffer 3, buffer 4, and distilled water.
Incubate glycochips with goat anti-mouse IgG+IgM (H+L) conjugated to biotin at 37 °C for 1 h.
Repeat the washing steps to remove unbound fraction.
Incubate glass slides in darkness at 25 °C for 45 min with streptavidin labeled with Cy5 dye diluted 1:500 in buffer 2.
Wash glycochips and dry by airflow in darkness.
